caption:
Line art on the left, colored on the right. The right side is up to you. 🎄

Four scenes from the Country Christmas book: the old pickup bringing the tree home, a wagon piled high with presents, candles in a cabin window, and a little roadside tree stand. I'd start with the truck.

There are 66 country Christmas scenes in bold, open line art. You can finish a page even if you're new to coloring, and there's enough detail to keep an experienced colorist busy.

It comes with 23 printable covers too, so you can bind the pages into your own book and wrap it as a gift. US Letter 8.5 x 11 in, print-ready PDF plus 300 dpi PNG and JPG files. Hit print. It fits.
